system.description:
When you @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.C9GvWd6IY5KcAgSI]{strike out with voice or violence} or @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.bJci1vpORz3rIoW4]{accuse someone of lying} while you have four conditions marked, ignore all penalties from conditions for those moves.

When you @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.C9GvWd6IY5KcAgSI]{strike out} at your Love or @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.bJci1vpORz3rIoW4]{accuse your Love of lying}, you may immediately swap your Love to the other Suitor to take a 10+ on the move.

When you @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.C9GvWd6IY5KcAgSI]{strike out} at your Love or @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.bJci1vpORz3rIoW4]{accuse your Love of lying}, you may immediately swap your Love to the other Suitor to take a 10+ on the move.
